name: EasyConnect interface standard
valueText: EasyConnect magnetic quick-change tool interface (Niryo standard)

name: Fragile-object contact criterion
valueText: Compliant/soft contact surface (Shore A < 60) or distributed multi-point contact to limit local pressure

name: Surface misalignment tolerance
valueText: Contact adapts to surface misalignment via compliant/adaptive principle

name: Minimum internal bore for expansion gripping
Vacuum surface criterion
valueText: Surface flatness within vacuum cup sealing tolerance, non-porous

name: Ferromagnetic contact area criterion
valueText: Ferromagnetic contact area at least equal to magnet pole face area

name: Replaceability criterion
valueText: Contact/wear part removable and replaceable without disassembling interface or actuator

name: Customizable contact geometry criterion
valueText: Contact geometry parametrically adjustable / re-printable per workpiece family

name: Minimum estimated contact friction
valueText: Estimated static friction coefficient, contact surface to object

name: Disassembly step criterion
valueText: Wear part removable in at most 3 tool-assisted steps without destroying structure or actuator

name: Repairability criterion
valueText: Contact/wear part independently replaceable via a documented Service process (see PROC_REPAIR)

name: Material diversity target
valueText: Target: single material across contact and interface parts where functionally feasible

name: Recyclability criterion
valueText: Structural material recyclable via standard metal or polymer recycling stream

name: Local AM manufacturability criterion
valueText: Manufacturable via FFF/SLS/MJF on desktop or regional AM service, no specialized tooling required

name: Reversible joining criterion
valueText: Joining technology reversible without destructive force (e.g. screw or clip - not adhesive or weld)

name: Data traceability convention
valueText: Assessment-relevant values carry DataSource and DataQuality provenance per modeling convention
